name: Tal-Barba Cave
description: Less dived cave about 200 m north of the seaward end of the Inland Sea tunnel, following the wall. The entrance at about 25 m looks like a beard ('barba' in Maltese); the straight cave runs some 120 m in, the exit always in view, with an air pocket to surface in. A long swim from shore, so often done with a small boat from the Inland Sea.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites. Position approximate.
